evidenceCases.assertion: A golden accepted receipt stream produces stable event IDs, event digests, source receipt identity, ordered subjects, and bounded payloads.
Registry definitions close kind/version, sensitivity, replayability, ordering, lifecycle, and compatibility metadata.
Zero, older, current, stale, cross-workspace, and forged checkpoints are explicit and validated.
Replay from zero or arbitrary checkpoint boundaries produces identical ordered event IDs and digests.
Duplicate delivery and crash-before/after-checkpoint boundaries have one logical effect and safe resume.
Sensitive canaries and internal-only material are redacted or rejected without checkpoint advancement.
Deleting derived events and checkpoints followed by bounded replay restores event and consumer digests without a provider row.
The hydrated fence is exactly 40 paths: 26 existing and 14 new, with zero overlap against the frozen S10 reservation.
All status flags remain false until accepted S10.6 reconciliation and later card gates.

requiredBehaviors.requirement: Accepted mutation receipts and journal entries project to immutable versioned events with stable source identity, revision, subject, visibility, timestamps, bounded payload, and canonical digests.
The registry declares event kind/version, source entity, sensitivity, replayability, ordering, lifecycle, and minimum compatible consumer version with canonical registry digest.
Per-consumer checkpoints are disposable operational state bound to workspace and registry identity; stale or cross-workspace checkpoints fail closed.
Replay order is accepted workspace revision, receipt identity, local sequence, and payload ordinal; replay from zero and arbitrary boundaries converge.
The single local conformance consumer applies duplicate delivery once and advances only after a valid event effect.
Sensitive inputs use identifiers-only redaction and internal-only material never crosses the declared visibility boundary.
Unknown event kinds or payload versions fail closed without advancing a checkpoint or changing canonical truth.
Projection and checkpoint caches are derived-only, disposable, and rebuilt from accepted receipts and journal truth with DROP_AND_REBUILD downgrade.
Static and runtime evidence keep transport, webhook, outbox, inbox, provider, credential, acknowledgement, and retry rows absent.
This lane is PASS_STATIC_PROVISIONAL and all native, hosted, adoption, acceptance, and release flags remain false.
